item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russia is intensifying airstrikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure, killing civilians in Zaporizhzhia and striking power plants in Kyiv, while Ukraine says it will pause its own refinery strikes if Russia ends its energy attacks. Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base and accused SpaceX of throttling Starlink terminals used by Kyiv forces for drones. Russian authorities detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges and announced a diesel deal framed as an energy ceasefire, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. The UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kurdish leaders Mazloum Abdi and Masrour Barzani met to discuss developments and Kurdish rights, and SDF forces remain outside the Syrian military structure.
